organization.notes: Community-maintained recruiting project; commercial CATSOne explicitly unaffiliated. Project start year not established after official overview/homepage/history search. No business equity funding model or named equity investors established.

pricingTiers.name: OpenCATS
pricingTiers.notes: No software subscription. Combined license has legacy CATS restrictions; not wholly OSI OSS. Infrastructure and optional external APIs separate.
No explicit Most popular or Recommended designation verified on the official plan page; no plan inferred.
No paid Business edition from OpenCATS; community application serves internal and agency recruiting. Unaffiliated CATSOne not substituted.
No paid Enterprise edition from OpenCATS established in official community overview.

moats.claim: Recruiting-specific candidate/client history provides modest workflow switching costs; differentiation is limited relative to modern commercial ATS suites, as project docs acknowledge.

productReasons.claim: Candidate records combine resumes, notes, status history and activity for coordinated recruiter follow-up.
Recruiting CRM connects jobs, client companies, contacts and submissions for staffing workflows.
Public job portal and candidate questionnaires feed applications into job pipelines.

sponsorship.notes: Reviewed project homepage, current README and community overview; no corporate financial/in-kind sponsors identified. OpenCATS is a community, with no verified business steward to substitute. CATSOne is explicitly unaffiliated; no inferred sponsor.
